title: Repeated-image EEG identification
disposition_reason: Public source implements a ten-person,200-candidate batch retrieval study with complete independent/programme/investigator comparisons. Authentic packets, numerical parity, execution containment and all30 scientific gates remain unqualified; source inspection is available but no current model result follows.

scientific_target.question: Can released80-repeat EEG means identify all200 test images of a held person without labeled target-person calibration, and how much do neural alignment and bounded investigator decisions contribute?
scientific_target.known_answer: A private bijection between200 opaque EEG query IDs and200 candidate-image IDs within each held-person panel.
scientific_target.answer_origin: THINGS-EEG2 original image/response association authenticated by source mapping, never candidate-assigned labels.
scientific_target.case_unit: A complete200-query held-person batch; the one-to-one assignment couples query decisions.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Ten people;200 shared images,80 repetitions,conditions/seeds and960 cells are not independent people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Batch-assisted image retrieval from repeated, released noise-normalized EEG. Independent-query metrics are needed to separate signal from the known one-to-one batch prior.
exclusions: No single-trial EEG decoding or strict inductive preprocessing claim.
No native direct or viewer understanding from F/I programme performance.

inputs: Per held-person query:80-repeat means over17 channels ×100 times; training four-repeat means on16,540 images from the other nine people.
200 candidate images through the fixed4096-dimensional feature representation plus authorized same-cell tools.
FULL,IMAGE_ONLY,ALIGN_SHUFFLE,PRE_ONLY,POST_ONLY matched arms in the full source study.
forbidden_inputs: Labeled outer-person calibration, any original test EEG during fitting, query image mapping and original ordering.
Cross-fold state or new inference-time fitting/normalization/calibration on query data.
observation_contract.case_identity: Exact opaque case/query/candidate IDs are in the future prepared ten-case panel; original subject identity and source mappings remain operator-side.
observation_contract.split: Ten isolated leave-one-person-out folds with all nine inner people and concept exclusions. Source-released session MVNN already mixes train/test covariance and must be disclosed even though supervised fitting excludes the outer person.
observation_contract.coverage: Ten panels ×200 queries. Current complete study specifies960 cells,96 panels,1,920 logical phases and150 reference banks; these are mandatory condition/workload counts, not additional tasks or executed cases.

primary.name: Participant-macro one-to-one assignment Top-1
primary.aggregation: Count correct bijective matches out of200 per person, then equal-weight ten people; report each frozen/investigator/tool condition separately.
primary.rationale: Matches the delivered complete-batch task while making the extra one-to-one prior explicit.

secondary: Independent-query Top-1, rank/log-loss metrics from the original scorer, and exact tie policy.
Paired FULL versus IMAGE_ONLY and ALIGN_SHUFFLE; PRE/POST comparisons; F/I and T0/T1 contrasts.
Coverage/failure bounds for incomplete panels remain diagnostics, not valid primary scores.

comparators.name: Independent R0/R1/R2/R3 banks
comparators.inputs: Frozen same-cell training support and candidate features
comparators.procedure: Implemented full-study reference bank generation; actual competence and source parity remain gates.

comparators.name: Candidate-only and alignment-shuffle controls
comparators.inputs: Same candidate roster with neural information absent or training alignment permuted
comparators.procedure: Implemented mandatory matched arms isolate batch/image priors and association use.

comparators.name: Independent-query decision
comparators.procedure: Score each row without assignment coupling and compare descriptively against exact maximum assignment.

nuisance_controls: Keep source image identity opaque and enforce concept-grouped training exclusions.
Report whitening/public source exposure and repeated-response aggregation; whitened coordinates are not raw microvolts.
Do not treat F/I equal allowances as equal consumption or unrestricted investigator semantics.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain all ten paired-person effects and shared-image pairing; source report uncertainty remains conditional on validated pairing/resampling and the fixed shared stimulus panel.
evaluation.failure_policy: Validate every submitted panel against exact public IDs before private targets. Missing cells retain costs/failures; incomplete-panel bounds cannot replace full-panel Top-1. No silent retries or denominator shrinkage.

implementation.scorer_target: Authentic held-person image identity with distinct independent and bijective scores; complete protected numerical route is source-implemented and genuine decoding rather than copying source results.
implementation.delivered_scope: Curated complete_study plus preparation/operator source; no authentic data/model assets or numerical execution qualification in this review.
missing: Bind authentic full-ten packets, exact image/EEG coordinates and feature checkpoints.
Qualify native boundaries, F/I semantic compliance, costs and independent target-last grading.
Run competent references and numerical agreement checks before scientific ranking.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source publication/inspection establishes integrity only; all30 scientific gates remain open and no new model or human attempt occurred.

direct_observation.representation: No-tools reading of compact EEG traces or candidate displays is not a current condition.
direct_observation.boundary: Current batch arrays and training/image models are tool/programme observations.
missing: Define faithful no-tools information view and independent response collector.

typed_viewer.representation: No typed EEG/candidate-image viewer is supplied.
typed_viewer.boundary: A viewer must preserve80-repeat representation and fixed candidate priors while hiding query associations.
missing: Audited viewer transport and complete-panel answer collection.

tool_assisted.representation: I: bounded online investigator decisions over authorized full-batch data/tools.
tool_assisted.boundary: Fresh same-cell context; only sealed action set; no new query fitting; full costs/failed operations retained.

frozen_program.representation: F: one precommitted numerical learning/search policy and sealed state.
frozen_program.boundary: No investigator decisions or generated analysis policy in F; fixed scientific predictor calls permitted only in their declared role.
missing: Full authentic execution and reference qualification.

summary: Make batch bijection a disclosed source of information and independent-query accuracy mandatory.
Tie the current full study to ten people, not960 benchmarks.
Distinguish bounded I semantics from direct interpretation and disclose transductive MVNN.
